documents.title: Inbound Receiving SOP
documents.text:
# Inbound Receiving SOP (SOP-006)

## Purpose
This procedure covers every inbound trailer arriving at a LOGFLOWS tenant warehouse. It is longer than a single retrieval window on purpose: dock clerks need numbered steps for seal check, temperature capture, discrepancy holds, and system updates. Do not skip a step to "save time" during peak. A missed seal photo or an unposted short is treated as a process failure, not a minor admin miss.

## Pre-arrival (T-60 to T-0)
Sixty minutes before the booked slot, the gate clerk confirms the appointment in the WMS, prints the expected ASN lines, and stages an empty dock with a working leveler. If the carrier is more than fifteen minutes late, record the delay code on the appointment and notify the Docken coordinator. Do not give away the door to another carrier without coordinator approval. Radios stay on channel DOCK-1. After 21:00 local, the night supervisor owns the door board.

## Seal, ID, and trailer condition
On arrival the clerk checks photo ID against the transport order, photographs the seal before it is cut, and writes the seal number on the inbound ticket. If the seal is broken, missing, or does not match the number on the CMR, stop. Do not open the doors. Page QC and security. Photograph the discrepancy, hold the driver in the gate office, and do not start unloading. A matching seal is not a quality release; it only authorizes opening the trailer.

## Temperature-controlled inbound
For reefer inbound, read the logger before the first pallet moves. Chilled product must sit between 2C and 8C. Frozen product must sit between -25C and -18C. If the reading is outside band, do not unload. Notify QC on-call within ten minutes using channel QC-1. QC decides quarantine or reject. This inbound SOP does not replace SOP-001 for outbound cold-chain delays; both can apply to the same trailer if it will later depart as an outbound reefer.

## Unload, count, and holds
Unload against the ASN. Scan each handling unit. Short, over, or damaged cartons go to the hold cage with a red ticket: SKU, expected qty, actual qty, photo, and driver name. Do not put hold stock onto an active pick face. If a pick face is already empty for an SKU on a live wave, that is a warehouse escalation under WH-ESC-002; receiving still must finish the hold ticket first. After the last pallet, the clerk and driver both sign the inbound ticket. Photo-only POD is not accepted for inbound either.

## System close and exceptions
Post the receipt in WMS before the driver leaves the yard. If WMS is down, use the paper inbound pack and enter it within thirty minutes of recovery. Never leave a trailer sealed to the building overnight without a posted receipt or an explicit night-supervisor hold. Missing diamonds or UN numbers on ADR inbound follow POL-HAZ-005: do not stage at the dock until labels are correct. This document does not contain customer freight rates, customs brokerage steps, or air IATA packing rules.
